more_info.overview: Fast Yellow AB is an azo dye supplied as an organic sodium salt. The dye molecule contains two sulphonate groups, and the PubChem identity record also describes use as a biological stain. Its appearance in historical food-colour lists concerns a former technological use. Current approval and food-use conditions must refer to the exact dye preparation.
